misconductScheme.description: The default scheme for cards; a competition can override it.

timeZone.description: Where the person is (PLAN-9): a plan ends at the end of its last day here. Filled in from the first browser or phone that signs in.

mapsApp.description: Where Directions open (WEB-14): auto (Apple Maps in the iPhone app, Google Maps everywhere else, the same when not set), or always Google Maps or Apple Maps.

maxHeartRate.description: Beats a minute, for heart-rate zones (TRK-4).

sprintKph.description: Where sprinting starts, in km/h, for the speed bands and sprints (TRK-11); the other bands scale with it. 21 when not set.

calendarArriveMin.description: Minutes before kickoff the calendar feed's events start, for travel and warming up (CAL-3); 0 starts them at kickoff. 30 when not set.

calendarReminderMin.description: Before several reminders (CAL-3): minutes before kickoff for the calendar feed's one reminder; 0 for none. Used only when none of calendarReminders, calendarDayBefore and calendarDayOf is set; 60 when nothing is.

calendarReminders.description: The calendar feed's reminders, in minutes before kickoff (CAL-3): 15-minute steps up to 3 hours.

calendarDayBefore.description: A reminder the day before a match at this time (HH:MM, in the match's time zone); none when not set.

watchScreen.description: Missing until it's first chosen: watches then keep two clocks stacked (time left over match time) with the time of day and names, or their own choice.

teamSwipes.description: For Garmin and Apple watches (INP-10); upDown when not set. Wear OS watches always swipe sideways, as a swipe down from the top opens their quick settings.

calendarDayOf.description: A reminder on the day of a match at this time (HH:MM, in the match's time zone), when that's before the event starts; none when not set.

nextMatchCollapsed.description: The match list's next match folded to a single strip (WEB-27); open when not set.

usualRole.description: The role a new match starts with on the match forms (SET-17); referee when not set. An import, an integration or a quick match from the watch keeps its own.

usualFormat.description: The format a new match starts with on the match forms (SET-17): the last one saved on a form, or chosen in Settings. Not set until then: forms start from defaultFormat (2×45), offering the starter formats. A competition's template still wins.

getReady.description: Get ready on Matches (WEB-32), the same on the website and the phones: what the person chose there, so it follows them to another browser or phone.

unitsConfirmed.description: They're right was chosen for the units and time zone guessed.

id.description: The id from the URL; can be left out.

version.description: The version last seen, when updating. Leave it out to create the record.

description: A UserSettings as a client sends it to save it: the server sets updatedAt and deletedAt, and version only goes with an update.
